svg.title: An IP packet carrying a WebSocket frame
svg.desc: Three headers stacked in the order they are sent. First the IP header (Version, IHL, Type of Service, Total Length, Identification, Flags, Fragment Offset, Time to Live, Protocol, Header Checksum, Source Address, Destination Address, Options, Padding). Then the TCP header (Source Port, Destination Port, Sequence Number, Acknowledgment Number, Data Offset, Reserved, flags, Window, Checksum, Urgent Pointer, Options, Padding). Then the WebSocket frame (FIN, RSV1-3, opcode, MASK, payload len, extended payload length, masking key, payload data).

g.text: Extended payload length continued, if payload len == 127
